# openclaw-rs
> Ultra-high-performance sovereign agent runtime in native Rust, Mojo 1.1 SIMD kernels, and Modular MAX local inference on Grace Blackwell GB10. Replaces the legacy Node.js/TypeScript OpenClaw stack with sub-millisecond execution, zero cloud token bills, and proactive autonomous heartbeats.

## Overview
- Repository: https://github.com/aien-dev/openclaw-rs
- License: Sovereign Reciprocal Commons License (SRCL-1.0), Apache 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions and Reciprocal AI Weight Release.
- Language: Rust 2021 + Mojo 1.1
- Runtime: Pure native compiled binaries. Zero Node.js. Zero Python daemons.

## Architecture
- Axum Gateway: Sub-millisecond WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and REST API on port 18096.
- Heartbeat Engine: Proactive autonomous background tick loop (60s period). Executes digital colleague workflows without requiring human prompts.
- Inference Engine: Direct HTTP client to Modular MAX serving local weights on port 18006 (`atlas-lightning-omni` on GB10). TTFT < 50ms.
- Persistence: Embedded SQLite with Write-Ahead-Logging (WAL) mode for sub-millisecond ACID history and state storage.
- Mojo SIMD Bridge: Zero-copy C-ABI FFI linking Mojo 1.1 vector kernels for cosine similarity and attention operations.
- Security: Hardware TPM key vault (`atlas-vault`). Zero disk secrets. Dynamic memory resolution and automatic secret redaction (`[REDACTED_BY_ATLAS_VAULT]`).

## Quickstart
```bash
cargo build --release
./target/release/openclaw serve --bind 0.0.0.0:18096
```

## Endpoints
- `GET /health`: Engine status, version, and hardware target.
- `GET /api/v1/status`: Comprehensive status with MAX connectivity and active tasks.
- `POST /api/v1/chat`: Direct inference request to local MAX.
- `GET /api/v1/heartbeat/tick`: Force an immediate heartbeat tick.
- `GET /ws`: Full duplex WebSocket interface for real-time agent coordination.
